rules.title: Community rules
rules.intro: @:{'site.name'} is a place to have fun and cheer each other on. A few rules keep it that way for everyone.

kind.title: Kindness first
kind.text: Vote for what you like best and don't make fun of anyone. No insults, hate or provocation in names and links.

own.title: Only your images, or with permission
own.text: Upload your own photos or work. If you didn't make it, you need the creator's permission and must credit them.

ai.title: No AI-made images
ai.text: We celebrate real people and real work here: AI-generated images are removed.

safe.title: Content for everyone
safe.text: No explicit, violent or disturbing content: people from 14 years old use the site.

privacy.title: Respect privacy
privacy.text: No addresses, license plates, phone numbers or faces of people who didn't agree.

report.title: If something's wrong, report it
report.text: Use "Report" on an image or a profile: only moderators read it. You can also block anyone who bothers you.

rules.outro: Breaking the rules can get images removed or an account suspended. Thanks for keeping this place nice!
rules.promptText: A few rules to keep this a kind place: respect, only your own work or with permission, no AI, no personal data. By continuing you accept them.

advertise.title: Get seen on @:{'site.name'}
advertise.lead: Your ad appears between one duel and the next, in front of people who are looking closely and voting. No pop-ups: a clear card marked “Sponsored”.

how.text: A full-height card with an image, a title, a short text and a button to your website. It stays until the person taps “Keep voting”.

cpc.text: You pay only when someone taps the ad and reaches your website.

report.text: Views and clicks for your campaign, in total and by different people. Links to your website carry utm_source, so your own analytics show the visits and purchases that came from here.

rules.title: What we accept
rules.text: We check every ad before it goes live. No adult content, gambling, weapons, misleading claims or products that can harm animals. We may refuse or remove an ad that breaks these rules.

totp.title: Two-step verification
totp.offText: When you sign in, besides your password we ask for a code from an authenticator app on your phone (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 2FAS, Aegis…). A stolen password is not enough.
totp.onText: On: when you sign in we also ask for the app code. Recovery codes left: {n}.
totp.requiredAdmin: You are an admin: turn on two-step verification to use the panel.
totp.scanLead: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, then type the 6-digit code it shows.
totp.qrLabel: QR code to scan with the authenticator app
totp.manual: Can't scan it? Add an account manually in the app with this key:
totp.openApp: I'm on my phone: open the app
totp.codesText: Keep them somewhere safe (a password manager, a printed sheet): each works once and lets you in if you lose your phone. We won't show them again.

totp.disableLead: To turn it off you need your password and an app or recovery code.
totp.renewLead: Type an app code: the old recovery codes will stop working.
